FLOSS: concept and layers

An operating model and sampling simulator for multi-fleet, multi-species fisheries whose truth is known. FLOSS builds the true age-structured dynamics with FLR and the data such a fishery produces, for trainees who predict and analyse, and trainers who hand out datasets with an answer key.

FLOSS: FL Operating model & Sampling Simulator, by Henning Winker. Built on FLR (FLCore, FLBRP, FLasher, FLife) and FLRef. Figures: reef example, 4 species and 3 fleets, 1969-2025.

Eight layers, each a plain R function or spec returning one object

The app only collects inputs and calls these functions, so everything done in the app can be repeated in a script. Pick a layer to see what goes in, what comes out, and what it looks like for the reef fishery.

Warning flags: patterns that real dynamics cannot produce

FLOSS lets trainers plant these on purpose and lists them in the answer key, so trainees learn to tell a data problem from a change in the stock.

Flag in the dataLikely cause, not real dynamics

The whole workflow in ten lines of R

load_fishery()→species_library()→build_oms()→run_treatment()→sample_data()→export_data()
library(FLOSS)
fy  <- load_fishery("reef_3fleets")                         # 3 fleets, 1969-2025
oms <- build_oms(species_library()$id, fy, nsim = 100)      # 4 species, calibrated to MSY
plot_om(oms)
dat <- sample_data(oms, reef_oem(), iters = 1:10)           # catch, effort, CPUE, survey, LFD, bio
plot_lfd(dat, "Lutjanus bohar")
sp  <- one_gear_species(load_species("lutjanus_bohar"))
rt  <- run_treatment(sp, one_gear_fishery(1), list(pulse = treatment("strong 2012 year class",
         recruitment = list(type = "pulse", years = 2012, mult = 8))), nsim = 10)
export_data(dat, "reef_course", format = c("csv", "xlsx"), zip = TRUE)   # + answer key

Install the FLR packages from https://flr.r-universe.dev, then remotes::install_github("Henning-Winker/FLOSS"). Source and guides: github.com/Henning-Winker/FLOSS.
